query:
WITH ViolationCounts AS
  (SELECT h.city,
          t.violation_type_description,
          COUNT(*) AS violation_count
   FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation t
   JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id
   JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location h ON d.id = h.id
   WHERE d.gender = 'M'
     AND t.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
     AND TRIM(t.violation_type_description) IS NOT NULL
     AND h.city IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY h.city,
            t.violation_type_description),
     RankedViolations AS
  (SELECT city,
          violation_type_description,
          violation_count,
          RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city
                       ORDER BY violation_count DESC) AS rnk
   FROM ViolationCounts)
SELECT city,
       violation_type_description,
       violation_count
FROM RankedViolations
WHERE rnk <= 5
ORDER BY city,
         rnk
LIMIT 100
